Usage: aigis [options] [command]

AI governance guardrails for coding agents

Options:
  -V, --version                       output the version number
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  classify [options] [description]    Classify an AI system and get recommended
                                      governance files
  get [options] [files...]            Fetch implementation pattern files
  verify [options] <files...>         Fetch verification checklists, or run
                                      deterministic auto-verify with --auto
  template <templates...>             Fetch compliance documentation templates
  workflow [options] [type]           Fetch the canonical file layout + wiring
                                      contracts for a project type
  build [options] <description>       Compose a consolidated governance brief
                                      for a feature description
  infra [options] [area]              Fetch infrastructure setup content
                                      (rate-limiting, secrets, logging)
  audit [options]                     Audit an existing codebase for governance
                                      gaps
  report [options]                    Compile an audit-ready compliance report
                                      (verify across multiple areas +
                                      cross-framework citations + evidence)
  search [options] [query]            Search across all content
  annotate [options] [fileId] [note]  Attach or manage local notes on content
                                      files
  init [options] <ide>                Set up aigis for your IDE (writes core
                                      skill + resolver block). Optional --ci
                                      and --hook activation surfaces.
  traits                              List all available classification traits
  help [command]                      display help for command
